label: primary
name: Primary Image Classification
description: Classify an image as full OCR, semi OCR, or non OCR based on whether its meaning depends primarily on text, both text and visual structure, or visual content.

labels.full_ocr: A text-dense document, form, invoice, receipt, contract, certificate, letter, report, or scanned book page.
labels.semi_ocr: A screenshot, webpage, app interface, chat, social media post, slide, table, chart, infographic, poster, menu, sign, comic, or meme where text and visual layout are both important.
labels.non_ocr: A photograph or visual image of people, animals, nature, products, vehicles, food, buildings, art, medical imagery, logos, icons, or graphics with little meaningful text.
